prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
answer_verbatim:
“Best” is subjective and depends on the facts of your case (severity of injuries, whether you need litigation, insurance limits, whether the other driver is uninsured, etc.). I can’t point to a single universal best lawyer, but I can:

- Tell you what to look for in a Chicago car‑accident attorney
- Give names of several well‑known Chicago plaintiff firms that handle serious car‑accident claims
- Provide a short list of questions to ask at a free consultation and next steps

What to look for
- Relevant experience with car-accident cases and similar injuries (e.g., spine, brain, catastrophic)
- Trial experience and a record of verdicts/settlements (important if insurer won’t negotiate)
- Good client communication and accessible staff
- Contingency-fee agreement (so you don’t pay unless you recover)
- Positive peer and client reviews; memberships in plaintiff groups (AAJ, Illinois Trial Lawyers, Super Lawyers listings)
- Willingness to coordinate medical care and handle liens/medical bills

Well-known Chicago plaintiff firms (not an exhaustive endorsement; check current reviews/results)
- Clifford Law Offices
- Corboy & Demetrio
- Levin & Perconti
- Romanucci & Blandin
- Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard

How to choose — questions to ask in the free consult
- How many car‑accident cases like mine have you handled?
- Have you gone to trial on similar cases? What were the results?
- Who will handle my case day to day — the named attorney or associates/ paralegals?
- What do you estimate my case is worth and why? (Expect a range, not a guarantee)
- What is your fee (contingency percentage) and who pays costs?
- How will you communicate case progress and how often?

Next steps
- If you want, tell me basic facts (when the crash happened, injuries, whether the other driver is insured, any police report, and your ZIP code). I can then help you narrow this to 3–5 attorneys to contact and draft a short phone/email script for consults.

If you already prefer I recommend one specific attorney from the list above, say so and I’ll pick one and summarize why they might fit typical serious car‑accident claims.
